org_variable.name: API_Token
org_variable.description: Rivhit API token

org_variable.name: Company_ID
org_variable.description: Rivhit company id, used to build PDF links

org_variable.name: Account_Mode
org_variable.description: demo or production — there is no separate Rivhit sandbox host

org_variable.name: Default_Language
org_variable.description: he or en — document language and widget direction

org_variable.name: Type_Cache
org_variable.description: JSON snapshot of the Rivhit type catalog

org_variable.name: Doc_Type_Roles
org_variable.description: JSON: default invoice, default sales order, credit, default receipt

org_variable.name: Payment_Type_Map
org_variable.description: JSON: CRM payment method to Rivhit payment_type

org_variable.name: Action_Permissions
org_variable.description: JSON permissions matrix, enforced server-side

org_variable.name: Sort_Code_VAT
org_variable.description: Rivhit sort code for VAT-liable documents

org_variable.name: Sort_Code_Exempt
org_variable.description: Rivhit sort code for VAT-exempt documents

org_variable.name: Default_Currency_ID
org_variable.description: Rivhit currency code used when the record does not specify one

org_variable.name: Default_Update_Inventory
org_variable.description: Initial state of the per-document stock checkbox

org_variable.name: Send_Mail_Default
org_variable.description: Whether Rivhit emails the document by default

org_variable.name: Digital_Signature
org_variable.description: Sign documents digitally

org_variable.name: Confirmation_Required
org_variable.description: Business is in the Israel Tax Authority allocation-number regime

org_variable.name: Approver_ID_Number
org_variable.description: ID number used to request an allocation number retroactively

org_variable.name: Monthly_Doc_Quota
org_variable.description: Subscribed monthly document tier; blank disables the warning

org_variable.name: Reconcile_Window_Days
org_variable.description: Rolling window for the scheduled reconciliation

org_variable.description: Enable the iCredit payment gateway features

org_variable.name: ICredit_Issues_Document
org_variable.description: True when the iCredit page issues the tax document itself

org_variable.name: ICredit_Test_Mode
org_variable.description: Use the iCredit test host and test token

org_variable.name: ICredit_Group_Token_Prod
org_variable.description: iCredit GroupPrivateToken, production

org_variable.name: ICredit_Group_Token_Test
org_variable.description: iCredit GroupPrivateToken, test

org_variable.name: ICredit_IPN_URL
org_variable.description: Public endpoint for successful payment notifications

org_variable.name: ICredit_IPN_Failure_URL
org_variable.description: Separate endpoint for declined charges

org_variable.name: ICredit_Redirect_URL
org_variable.description: Thank-you page shown after a successful payment

org_variable.name: Usage_Counter
org_variable.description: JSON monthly document issuance counter

org_variable.name: Sync_State
org_variable.description: JSON cursor for resumable batch jobs
